lemma innings (x : ℝ) (hy:x∈s): Ingredients (lens H) (Marlin.dummy (graft H he W d x)) (raiser B) 0 (Time.forecastK A.B.a m S (Q x).beta):= by
  let v':=forecastK A.B.a m S (Q x).beta; let y:= H.latch x; let J':= B; let T:= uptick H d x
  have h' (i:Site (A.B.a.S.side m n)):= worthy h hm H hc he hh hx W d x i
  have hm (s t) : Nonempty ((H.doors.read T).Moves s t):= Beam.moves _ _ Chi.canonical _ s t _
  have hz := H.honors (H.latch x)
  let f:=Marlin.tithe (2*e) (tempe (A:=A) (Z:=Z) (C:=C) (m:=m)) (B) (coverTicket k)
  have hc' i : (coverNumber (B).B (neighbors (2*e) (i:Site (A₀))):ℝ) ≤ coverTicket k:= by
    unfold coverTicket; apply Nat.cast_le.mpr; apply le_trans (Trio.scaleMeters k (radiusB x₀) (B).B_pos i _ le_rfl); rw [two_mul]
  have ht : 0≤ tempe (A:=A) (Z:=Z) (C:=C) (m:=m):= (norm_nonneg _).trans ((h' 0).2.2 1)
  have hF : 0≤f:= by unfold f Marlin.tithe; positivity
  have hR := h.conducts.income
  let c:=Cash.armK (C Jp Ip) L₀ (R.μ Jp Ip) x₀ 0 (Z Jp Ip).degrees
  have hb := (he _ hy).2
  have hu := Opera.backing A.B R hR hb
  let S':= X.p.profile Ip
  have hk := Rain.jersey (A:=A) (m:=m)
  have hr : c ≤ v'/8:= hu.trans_eq (by unfold v'; ring)
  let i := step_paid A.B.a m
  have hx : (B).supportExponent+3≤(Z Jp Ip).earn:= by rw [hk.2.2.1]; exact h.agenda _ _ i|>.1
  have ht': (raiser (B)).supportExponent+1≤ (Z Jp Ip).earn:= by change (B).supportExponent+1+1≤_; linarith
  obtain ⟨k',hq,hZ⟩:= Refrain.chargesOut (raiser B) H.base (H.sister (H.latch x)) O hz rfl ht'
  have hP := (hh.terms.allot _ _ i _ (A.B.valid.pays m)); obtain ⟨hk',-,hK,-⟩:= hP
  have hv : (Q x).beta ∈ band A.B.a (m+1):= hb
  let v β:=(S Jp Ip).pair.strong (betaF G x₀ L₀) β
  have hν : Next.Scheduling.inBand (betaF G x₀ L₀) (Q x).beta:=by rw [← PriceCompiler.beta_eq A.B.valid]; exact trial_in hb
  have hv' : v' = v (Q x).beta := by unfold v' forecastK; rw [PriceCompiler.beta_eq A.B.valid]
  have he':f ≤ betaF G x₀ L₀ ^ (-(1/8:ℝ)):= by unfold f Marlin.tithe; rw [hk.2.2.1]; exact hk'
  change Ingredients _ _ _ _ v'; rw [hv']; obtain ⟨η,hg⟩:= hK _ hν c f (budget_nonneg (hZ 0)) hF (show c≤ v _/8 from hr.trans_eq (congr_arg (fun i:ℝ=>i/8) hv')) he'
  exact Marlin.stakes (B) H.doors e (2*e) T _ _ (Refrain.qualified _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl) hm hg hq hZ (fun i=> (h' i).1) (fun i=> (h' i).2.1) (fun i=> (h' i).2.2) hc' (le_refl f)

proof_context.conclusion: Using worthy (L_x tidy, vanishing on healthy sets, bounded), the site bound tithe <= beta^{-1/8} and the forced pair cost with margin c <= v'/8, the forced family multiplied by the logarithmic factors meets Ingredients with forced bound forecastK.

lemma sous (H : Ingredients X (dummy d) (raiser B) 0 w) (V:Meadow.Budget B X.reg d.regular e) (hp:∀ s b,Nonempty ((X.pours d).Moves s b)) : Collection.Local (pluck B X) B (poursP B X d) e w:= by
  obtain ⟨f,h,hf⟩:=V
  obtain ⟨a,b,u,h',hB,hQ⟩:= H.pays
  obtain ⟨z,hZ,hr⟩:= Work.H02.answer G c X (dummy d) (hak X) _ _ a b _ (raiser B) hQ h' hB
  have he := Work.H03.fused_forcedFamily (hak X) h'
  refine ⟨(fun i=>(hf i).1), ?_, fun s b=> ledger h' s b (hp s b|>.some), ⟨_,fun i=> (hf i).2,h⟩, ⟨_,hZ,fun x=>?_⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨he.sym,he.symtest,he.meas,he.meas_test,he.reads,he.reads_test,he.permit⟩
  convert hr x using 2 with i; simp only [BudgetPoint.mass]; rw [mul_comm (z i)]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: From these Ingredients, the fusion Work.H02.answer gives the collected forced family with its site bound (Collection.Local).
